package udp_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	cnet "github.com/xtls/xray-core/common/net"
	"github.com/xtls/xray-core/transport/internet"
	"net"
	"os"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Construct the equal-port kernel condition with native sockets. The outbound
// socket is opened first, unlike the natural SOCKS failure; report that boundary.
func TestSocketPortAttribution(t *testing.T) {
	if os.Getenv("XRAY_CONTROL_ATTRIBUTION") != "1" {
		t.Fatal("attribution execution flag absent")
	}
	if controlMode(t) != "off" {
		t.Fatal("socket attribution requires OFF")
	}
	dialer := new(internet.DefaultSystemDialer)
	conn, err := dialer.Dial(context.Background(), nil, cnet.UDPDestination(cnet.LocalHostIP, 9), nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { conn.Close() })
	packet, ok := conn.(*cnet.PacketConnWrapper)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected native UDP type %T", conn)
	}
	port := conn.LocalAddr().(*net.UDPAddr).Port
	echo, err := net.ListenUDP("udp4", &net.UDPAddr{IP: net.IPv4(127, 0, 0, 1), Port: port})
	if err != nil {
		t.Logf("CONTROL_KERNEL outcome=bind-rejected outbound=%v requested-echo=127.0.0.1:%d err=%v", conn.LocalAddr(), port, err)
		return
	}
	t.Cleanup(func() { echo.Close() })
	packet.Dest = echo.LocalAddr()
	payload := []byte("equal-port-native-write")
	conn.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
	echo.SetDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
	n, err := conn.Write(payload)
	t.Logf("CONTROL_KERNEL outbound-write local=%v dest=%v n=%d err=%v", conn.LocalAddr(), packet.Dest, n, err)
	if err != nil || n != len(payload) {
		t.Fatalf("native write result %d/%v", n, err)
	}
	buffer := make([]byte, 256)
	n, peer, readErr := echo.ReadFromUDP(buffer)
	t.Logf("CONTROL_KERNEL echo-read local=%v peer=%v n=%d err=%v", echo.LocalAddr(), peer, n, readErr)
	var replyReturnedToEcho bool
	if readErr == nil {
		if !bytes.Equal(buffer[:n], payload) {
			t.Fatal("echo payload changed")
		}
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			buffer[i] ^= 0x19
		}
		written, writeErr := echo.WriteToUDP(buffer[:n], peer)
		t.Logf("CONTROL_KERNEL echo-write peer=%v n=%d err=%v", peer, written, writeErr)
		if writeErr != nil || written != n {
			t.Fatal("echo write failed")
		}
		wantReply := append([]byte(nil), buffer[:n]...)
		echo.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(250 * time.Millisecond))
		repeated, sender, repeatErr := echo.ReadFromUDP(buffer)
		t.Logf("CONTROL_KERNEL echo-read-reply peer=%v n=%d err=%v payload=%x", sender, repeated, repeatErr, buffer[:max(0, repeated)])
		replyReturnedToEcho = repeatErr == nil && bytes.Equal(buffer[:repeated], wantReply)
	}
	conn.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(2 * time.Second))
	n, err = conn.Read(buffer)
	t.Logf("CONTROL_KERNEL outbound-read local=%v n=%d err=%v payload=%x", conn.LocalAddr(), n, err, buffer[:max(0, n)])
	if readErr != nil && err == nil && bytes.Equal(buffer[:n], payload) {
		t.Log("CONTROL_KERNEL outcome=self-delivery echo-not-received outbound-returned-original")
	} else if readErr == nil && err == nil {
		want := append([]byte(nil), payload...)
		for i := range want {
			want[i] ^= 0x19
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(buffer[:n], want) {
			t.Fatal("outbound did not receive echo reply")
		}
		t.Log("CONTROL_KERNEL outcome=echo-roundtrip")
	} else if replyReturnedToEcho && err != nil {
		t.Log("CONTROL_KERNEL outcome=reply-returned-to-echo outbound-no-reply")
	} else {
		t.Logf("CONTROL_KERNEL outcome=no-delivery echo-error=%v outbound-error=%v", readErr, err)
	}
}
